diagnosis: All four rollouts passed without setting any of the required facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4). This indicates that the checks C1 through C9 are not dependent on the hidden information provided by PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4. Instead, the rollouts defaulted to common practices such as full rollout percentages, standard observation periods, and general commitments like functional and reliability testing, which do not require the specific hidden information.
